doc: One civic building to build (design/planner.md, Civic buildings): its type, the lot size it stands on, how grand it is, and the season.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Its lot: centre (flower7), small (rect6x5), large (rect9x7), or great (rect12x9).

fields.name: theme
fields.doc: The village theme: its architecture and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: How far it has come: planning (its lot staked out, materials piled), half (walls half up in scaffolding), finished, or a ruin.

fields.name: grandeur
fields.doc: How grand it is: plain, fine, grand (gilding, statues, braziers), or wondrous (the exotic: crystal finials, twin towers, flying buttresses, a colossus).
